alternatives.why: also serves this channel; it holds no getting-started page

issues.title: docs: the install link points at a moved page
issues.body:
## What is wrong
The install link on the docs landing page points at a page that moved.

## What it should be
It points at the page that page moved to.

## Acceptance check
The landing page's install link reaches the install page in one click.

issues.title: docs: the quickstart names a removed flag
issues.body:
## What is wrong
The quickstart passes a flag the current release removed.

## What it should be
It passes the flag the current release reads.

## Acceptance check
A reader following the quickstart gets a working install.

issues.title: docs: the upgrade page omits the migration step
issues.body:
## What is wrong
The upgrade page does not mention the migration the new release needs.

## What it should be
It names the migration and when to run it.

## Acceptance check
An operator upgrading from the previous release runs the migration first.
